items.description: S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/landing capability, ~15,000 ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical sounding payload

notes: Early-stage concept for S0-VTOL launch/recovery from NOAA research vessel Ron Brown with autonomous ship landing, atmospheric sounding mission (45-day cruise, ~8 hr data turnaround). Preliminary ~$18k funding identified; customer pursuing additional Ron Brown funding. Target Spring 2028 mission. Collaboration includes publication requirements.
